# Add test case for exclude_detection_period_from_training flag validation (CORE-19)

## Summary
Adds a test case that demonstrates the current behavior of volume anomaly detection when anomalous data exists in the detection period. This test is part of the groundwork for implementing the `exclude_detection_period_from_training` flag described in [CORE-19](https://linear.app/elementary/issue/CORE-19/create-test-case-for-exclude-detection-period-from-training-flag).

The test creates a scenario with:
- 30 days of normal data (100 rows/day baseline)
- 7 days of anomalous data (500 rows/day, 5x spike) in the detection period
- Validates that the anomaly is detected (test status = fail)

**Key Finding**: The 5x spike is large enough to be detected even though the detection period data is included in the cumulative training baseline. This documents current behavior and provides a foundation for testing the flag implementation.

## Review & Testing Checklist for Human

- [ ] **Verify test scenario alignment**: Review whether this test scenario (5x spike) accurately demonstrates the problem CORE-19 is trying to solve. The Linear ticket suggests anomalies should be MISSED when included in training, but this large spike is still detected. Consider if a more subtle/gradual anomaly scenario would better demonstrate the masking effect.
  
- [ ] **Review test assertion logic**: The test asserts `status == "fail"` (anomaly detected), which documents current behavior but may not align with the original ticket description of anomalies being missed. Confirm this is the intended approach.

- [ ] **Validate TODO comments**: Review the TODO section (lines 78-92) for implementing the flag test. Verify this structure will be useful when the actual flag is implemented.

- [ ] **Run the test locally**: Execute `cd integration_tests/tests && pytest test_exclude_detection_period_from_training.py -vvv --target elementary_tests` to verify it passes in your environment.

### Notes
- Test currently only validated on Postgres (elementary_tests target)
- Test is marked to skip ClickHouse (line 12)
- The cumulative window function in `get_anomaly_scores_query.sql` (lines 167-171) includes all data up to the current row in training, which is the behavior this flag aims to address
- Pre-commit hooks passed (black, isort, flake8, prettier, typos)
